concerns.text: FR-002 requires a 'lightweight discrete diffusion model'; T003 substitutes distilgpt2, an autoregressive causal LM, wrapped in a hand-rolled masking process. This is a semantic weakening of FR-002 — the deliverable is not a discrete diffusion model. The spec's assumed checkpoint (author/lightdiff-100m) is admittedly nonexistent, so the spec assumption and the task workaround must be reconciled explicitly (amend FR-002 or document the substitution as sanctioned), not silently relaxed in the task.

The active contract requires a SINGLE StatisticalResult object with required fields t_test_result, quadratic_coefficients, peak_density, sensitivity_slopes, entropy_error_correlation, analysis_timestamp. Tasks write four separate files (paired_t_test.json, quadratic_fit.json, sensitivity_analysis.json, entropy_error_corr.json), none of which can validate against the schema; T013's contract tests and SC-006 would fail. Restructure to emit one schema-conformant object (or amend the contract).

Plan mandates ten seeds (42-51) and a power analysis 'confirming >= 0.80 with ten seeds'; tasks run only five seeds (42-46), recording the reduction only in run metadata. FR-009's '>= 5' floor is met, but the plan's constraint is silently relaxed and the plan's power claim becomes unsatisfiable as written. Reconcile the seed count in one place with documented justification (spec amendment or plan revision), not a task-side note.

FR-005 requires the hard 6-hour timeout with checkpoint saving for the training process generally (See US-1, US-2), but only T005 implements the epoch-start timeout check; T004 (thin run) and T007 (adaptive + control runs) omit timeout enforcement/checkpointing, leaving FR-005 partially uncovered for adaptive/control conditions.

FR-001 requires downloading AND preprocessing the bigbench_lite logical-deduction subset; T002 downloads it but no subsequent task (T004/T005/T007/T008) uses it for training or evaluation. Either add a task that consumes it or document in the spec that it is download-only, so the requirement is not silently narrowed to GSM8K.

US-1 scenario 3 requires logging step-level accuracy and the per-step density value in the metadata file; tasks record only loss_trajectory, final metrics, and (adaptive-only) density_time_series. Step-level accuracy logging has no implementing task — an acceptance criterion dropped.

Verification runs `print(len(d))` on a streaming IterableDataset, which raises TypeError — the stated checkable condition for FR-001's fail-loudly loader cannot pass as written. Fix the verification to materialize/count via islice as the task body itself prescribes.

Sensitivity sweep uses a single seed (42) while all other statistical tasks use five; the asymmetry and its noise implications are undocumented. FR-007 does not mandate seeds, but the inconsistency should be stated (or seeds added) so SC-004's 'stability' measurement isn't silently weakened.

SC-005 measures total wall-clock time of the full experiment suite against the 6-hour limit, but no task aggregates or reports suite-level wall-clock (only per-run runtime_seconds exists). Add an aggregation step or note where SC-005 evidence is produced.
